result: I fixed the missing authorization check on `PostController.destroy` in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:99-107`, adding `await this.authorize('delete', [Post, post])` before deletion — mirroring the pattern already used by `update`, and reusing the `PostPolicy.delete` rule that already existed but was never invoked.
